note: Descriptions transcribed verbatim from the SEC Form 4 instructions.

P.desc: Open market or private purchase of non-derivative or derivative security

S.desc: Open market or private sale of non-derivative or derivative security

V.desc: Transaction voluntarily reported earlier than required

A.desc: Grant, award or other acquisition pursuant to Rule 16b-3(d)

D.desc: Disposition to the issuer of issuer equity securities pursuant to Rule 16b-3(e)

F.desc: Payment of exercise price or tax liability by delivering or withholding securities incident to the receipt, exercise or vesting of a security issued in accordance with Rule 16b-3

I.desc: Discretionary transaction in accordance with Rule 16b-3(f) resulting in acquisition or disposition of issuer securities

M.desc: Exercise or conversion of derivative security exempted pursuant to Rule 16b-3

H.desc: Expiration (or cancellation) of long derivative position with value received

X.desc: Exercise of in-the-money or at-the-money derivative security

G.group: Other Section 16(b) Exempt Transaction and Small Acquisition Codes

L.group: Other Section 16(b) Exempt Transaction and Small Acquisition Codes

W.group: Other Section 16(b) Exempt Transaction and Small Acquisition Codes
W.desc: Acquisition or disposition by will or the laws of descent and distribution

Z.group: Other Section 16(b) Exempt Transaction and Small Acquisition Codes
Z.desc: Deposit into or withdrawal from voting trust

K.desc: Transaction in equity swap or instrument with similar characteristics

U.desc: Disposition pursuant to a tender of shares in a change of control transaction
